import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = "budget.xlsx"

# pandas view
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
for name in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=name, header=None)
    print(f"\n--- pandas sheet: {name} (shape {df.shape}) ---")
    print(df.to_string())
    num = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number])
    print("pandas sum of all numeric cells:", num.to_numpy().sum())

# openpyxl view (shows formulas too)
wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=False)
for ws in wb.worksheets:
    print(f"\n--- openpyxl sheet: {ws.title} (dims {ws.dimensions}) ---")
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for c in row:
            if c.value is not None:
                print(c.coordinate, repr(c.value))

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

path = "budget.xlsx"
M = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
ns = {"m": M}

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))

cells = {}
for c in root.iter(M + "c"):
    cells[c.get("r")] = c

def num(ref):
    c = cells[ref]
    v = c.find(M + "v")
    return float(v.text)

expense_refs = ["C11", "C12", "C13", "C14", "C15", "C16",
                "C17", "C18", "C19", "C20", "C21", "C22"]
vals = [num(r) for r in expense_refs]
print("Expense values C11:C22:", vals)
print("Total expenses across all categories:", sum(vals))

# sanity: other groups in the sheet
print("B4:B7 sum:", sum(num(r) for r in ["B4", "B5", "B6", "B7"]))
